title: Dissecting the Ecological Structure of Health and Disease in the Global Gut Microbiome
authors: Baoyuan Zhu, Shuhao Chen, Yunheng Diao, Wei Wang, et al.
focus: Across 20,178 metagenomes and 36 countries, continuous microbial ecological factors described overlapping patterns of health and disease.
focusZh: 整合20,178份来自36国的宏基因组，使用连续微生物生态因子表征健康与疾病之间可重叠的群落变化。
citation: Zhu B, Chen S, Diao Y, et al. Dissecting the Ecological Structure of Health and Disease in the Global Gut Microbiome. Advanced Science. 2026;13(44):e17087. https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.202517087

title: The Brain–Gut Health Initiative (BIGHI): A Prospective Cohort on Psychiatric Disorders in China
authors: Fengchun Wu, Baoyuan Zhu, Shixuan Feng, et al.
focus: Describes a prospective brain–gut cohort framework integrating clinical, microbiome and neuroimaging measurements for psychiatric research.
focusZh: 介绍整合临床评估、微生物组与脑影像的前瞻性脑肠健康队列及其研究框架。
citation: Wu F, Zhu B, Feng S, et al. The Brain–Gut Health Initiative (BIGHI): A Prospective Cohort on Psychiatric Disorders in China. Research. 2026;9:1142. https://doi.org/10.34133/research.1142

title: Integrative multi-kingdom gut microbiome analysis uncovers clinical signatures of major depressive disorder
authors: Shuhao Chen, Baoyuan Zhu, Xiaodan Lu, et al.
focus: Metagenomic analysis of bacteria, archaea, viruses and eukaryotes in first-episode, drug-naïve depression, including clinical associations and exploratory classifiers.
focusZh: 在首发未用药抑郁症队列中联合分析细菌、古菌、病毒和真核微生物，并探索临床关联与辅助区分模型。
citation: Chen S, Zhu B, Lu X, et al. Integrative multi-kingdom gut microbiome analysis uncovers clinical signatures of major depressive disorder. Journal of Affective Disorders. 2026;408:121858. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jad.2026.121858

title: Continuous Alterations in the Gut Microbial Landscape Associated With Suicidal Ideation in First-Episode Drug-naïve Major Depressive Disorder
authors: Liqin Liang, Shuhao Chen, Baoyuan Zhu, et al.
focus: Reports continuous microbiome changes associated with suicidal ideation in a first-episode, drug-naïve MDD cohort; associations do not establish causality.
focusZh: 分析首发未用药抑郁症中与自杀意念相关的连续肠道微生态改变；观察性关联不等于因果证据。
citation: Liang L, Chen S, Zhu B, et al. Continuous Alterations in the Gut Microbial Landscape Associated With Suicidal Ideation in First-Episode Drug-naïve Major Depressive Disorder. CNS Neuroscience & Therapeutics. 2026;32(6):e70892. https://doi.org/10.1002/cns.70892

title: Microbiota-immune crosstalk underlying cancer-induced depression in patients with breast cancer
authors: Yuanyuan Li, Baoyuan Zhu, Xiaomei Wu, et al.
focus: Explores associations among gut microbiota, inflammatory cytokines and mood changes in people undergoing breast-cancer treatment.
focusZh: 研究乳腺癌治疗相关抑郁中肠道微生物、炎症因子和情绪变化之间的统计关联。
citation: Li Y, Zhu B, Wu X, et al. Microbiota-immune crosstalk underlying cancer-induced depression in patients with breast cancer. Journal of Affective Disorders. 2026;407:121694. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jad.2026.121694

title: Gut microbiota mediates the beneficial effects of exercise on autism-like behaviors
authors: Jiugen Zhong, Baoyuan Zhu, Zhi Zou, et al.
focus: Animal-model study assessing exercise, fecal microbiota transfer and behavioral outcomes, with implications constrained to the experimental model.
focusZh: 通过动物模型评估运动、粪菌移植与行为变化之间的关系，研究结论需限定于实验模型。
citation: Zhong J, Zhu B, Zou Z, et al. Gut microbiota mediates the beneficial effects of exercise on autism-like behaviors. BMC Microbiology. 2026;26:157. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12866-025-04632-x

title: Analysis of individualized brain–gut association networks and transcriptional patterns in major depressive disorder
authors: Wei Wang, Baoyuan Zhu, Yuanyuan Huang, et al.
focus: Analyzes individualized microbiome–brain association networks and contextualizes their regional patterns using external transcriptomic references.
focusZh: 研究个体化微生物组—脑网络关联，并利用外部转录组参考图谱解释其脑区分布。
citation: Wang W, Zhu B, Huang Y, et al. Analysis of individualized brain–gut association networks and transcriptional patterns in major depressive disorder. Interdisciplinary Medicine. 2026. https://doi.org/10.1002/inmd.70165

title: Multi-kingdom microbial changes and their associations with the clinical characteristics in schizophrenia patients
authors: Baoyuan Zhu, Liqin Liang, Shuhao Chen, et al.
focus: Profiles bacterial, archaeal, fungal and viral community differences and their clinical correlates in schizophrenia.
focusZh: 比较精神分裂症人群的细菌、古菌、真菌和病毒特征及其临床关联。
citation: Zhu B, Liang L, Chen S, et al. Multi-kingdom microbial changes and their associations with the clinical characteristics in schizophrenia patients. Translational Psychiatry. 2025;15:228. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41398-025-03449-6

title: Exploring the relationship between the gut microbiota and cognitive function in schizophrenia patients with distinct weights
authors: Baoyuan Zhu, Liqin Liang, Yuanyuan Huang, et al.
focus: Examines how BMI-stratified gut microbial profiles relate to cognitive outcomes in schizophrenia.
focusZh: 分析不同体重分层的精神分裂症人群中肠道微生物组与认知表现的关系。
citation: Zhu B, Liang L, Huang Y, et al. Exploring the relationship between the gut microbiota and cognitive function in schizophrenia patients with distinct weights. Schizophrenia Research. 2025;280:103–113. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.schres.2025.04.017

title: The association between gut microbiota and functional connectivity in cognitive impairment of first-episode major depressive disorder
authors: Yuanyuan Huang, Hehua Li, Baoyuan Zhu, et al.
focus: Explores microbiome–functional connectivity associations in cognitive impairment in first-episode depression.
focusZh: 探索首发抑郁症认知损害中，微生物组差异与脑功能连接的统计关联。
citation: Huang Y, Li H, Zhu B, et al. The association between gut microbiota and functional connectivity in cognitive impairment of first-episode major depressive disorder. Translational Psychiatry. 2025. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41398-025-03615-w
